strings.ACCESS_NOTE: Each reveal and copy is logged, never the value.
strings.ARCHIVED_EMPTY_BODY: Archived items are kept but hidden from lists.
strings.CODE_COPIED: Code copied. Clears when the code changes.
strings.CODE_NOT_A_SEED: That setup key makes no codes. Edit the item and paste it again.
strings.COMPROMISED_CLEARS: Saving a new password clears this flag.
strings.COMPROMISED_NOTE: Listed in Review until you save a new password.
strings.COMPROMISED_NOTE_NO_PASSWORD: Listed in Review until you clear the flag.
strings.DAY_ONE_BODY: Add a login, card or note.
strings.DENIED_BODY: Access to Locker's items was refused.
strings.DISCARD_BODY: Unsaved changes, including typed secrets, are lost.
strings.EDITOR_LEDE: Secrets are encrypted when you save.
strings.EXPORT_COMMIT_NOTE: Confirm it's you, then choose where to save.
strings.EXPORT_CONFIRM_BODY: Anything that opens the file can read your secrets. You'll confirm it's you first.
strings.EXPORT_CONFIRM_TITLE: Write every secret to a file?
strings.EXPORT_FORMAT_JSON_NOTE: Everything, for importing back into Locker.
strings.EXPORT_LEAVES_OUT: Not included: trash, old passwords, passkey keys.
strings.EXPORT_LEDE: This saves every item, including passwords, to an unencrypted file. Anything that opens it can read your secrets.
strings.EXPORT_NO_SAVER: This phone cannot save the file.
strings.EXPORT_PROMPT_REASON: Confirm it's you to export every secret.
strings.EXPORT_PROMPT_SUBTITLE: Anything that reads the file reads your secrets.
strings.EXPORT_WHERE_NOTE: Locker keeps no copy. Protect the file yourself.
strings.EXPORT_WRITTEN: File written. It holds every secret.
strings.EXPORT_WRITTEN_PARTIAL: File written. {n} secrets could not be read and are missing.
strings.FACT_LEAVING_DETAIL: Locks when you leave. Copied secrets clear in 30 seconds.
strings.FACT_REVEAL_DETAIL: One field at a time, for 30 seconds
strings.FIELD_REMOVE_BODY: Its value is erased. This cannot be undone.
strings.FIELD_TEXT_NOTE: Plain text, shown on the item.
strings.IMPORT_DONE_NOTE: The file still holds every secret. Delete it when done.
strings.IMPORT_FAILED: That file could not be read.
strings.IMPORT_FILE_NOTE: A password-manager CSV or a Locker export.
strings.IMPORT_LEDE: Choose a file, review it, then add.
strings.IMPORT_NOTHING: No items found in that file
strings.IMPORT_NOT_READABLE: That isn't a password-manager CSV or a Locker export.
strings.IMPORT_PUBLISH_NOTE: Held rows stay as they are.
strings.IMPORT_VERDICT_HELD: already in Locker, kept as is
strings.IMPORT_VERDICT_SKIPPED: not an item, or a repeat of an earlier row
strings.ITEMS_STATUS: Secrets stay hidden until you reveal them.
strings.ITEM_GONE_BODY: It was erased, or never on this phone.
strings.ITEM_STATUS: Revealed secrets hide again after 30 seconds.
strings.KEEPS_BACKUP_DETAIL: Stored encrypted on your backup device.
strings.KEEPS_LIST_DETAIL: Titles, usernames, addresses and tags. Searchable.
strings.KEEPS_RECEIPTS_DETAIL: Each unlock and reveal, with the time
strings.LOCK_BODY_LEAD: Items stay hidden until you unlock with
strings.LOCK_DID_NOT_OPEN: Locker did not open on this phone.
strings.LOCK_FAILED: Not recognised. Try again, or use the passcode.
strings.LOCK_FAILED_PASSCODE: That did not unlock Locker. Try again.
strings.LOCK_LOCKED_OUT: Too many tries. Unlock the phone with its passcode, then try again.
strings.LOCK_NO_WORDS_BODY: This phone doesn't hold the recovery key for this vault.
strings.LOCK_NO_WORDS_NOTICE: Secrets open once you enter it.
strings.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE_BODY: Locker opens with this phone's own lock, and this phone has none.
strings.LOCK_UNAVAILABLE_NOTICE: Set a passcode in Settings, then come back.
strings.LOOKALIKES: Skips look-alikes such as 0, O, 1 and l.
strings.NO_ANSWER: The lock didn't respond. Try again.
strings.NO_VAULT: No vault is open on this phone.
strings.OTP_COUNTER_BASED: Locker needs a time-based code. Ask the site for one.
strings.OTP_NOT_A_SEED: That isn't a setup key. Paste the key or otpauth:// link.
strings.PASSKEY_NOTE: Stored, never shown. Locker cannot use passkeys on this phone.
strings.PASSKEY_REMOVE_BODY: Its key is erased. Remove it from the site too.
strings.PROMPT_REASON: Unlock Locker to see your items and reveal a secret.
strings.PROMPT_SUBTITLE: Your items stay covered until you do.
strings.PURGE_BODY: It's erased with its secrets and history. This cannot be undone.
strings.READ_INCOMPLETE: Locker could not read this item.
strings.REVEAL_DID_NOT_OPEN: That secret did not open on this phone.
strings.REVEAL_GONE: That item is no longer here.
strings.REVEAL_LOCKED: Locker locked before it could reveal that.
strings.REVEAL_SEED: The setup key stays hidden. Use Show code.
strings.REVIEW_BREACH_REASON: Checking would send data off this phone.
strings.REVIEW_CLEAR_BODY: No item is flagged, served over http, or past its expiry.
strings.REVIEW_COMPROMISED_REASON: Marked by you. Change the password where it's used.
strings.REVIEW_EXPIRING_REASON: Expires this month or within the next two.
strings.REVIEW_HTTP_REASON: An http address sends what you type in the clear.
strings.REVIEW_WEAK_REASON: Checking would expose every password at once.
strings.SEARCH_NOTE: Secrets and notes are not searched.
strings.TRASH_EMPTY_BODY: Trashed items stay for thirty days.
